- Admin settings: Save works again (the Google Calendar card no longer breaks the form), and saving Google Calendar credentials no longer crashes the page.
- Google Calendar: tenants can now connect and disconnect their own calendar from Bot settings > Appointments.
- Voice notes: the model dropdown now lists every model your plan allows (FenLLM Pro/Max included).
- Orders: changing an order that is still New or Confirmed edits it in place - same order number, kitchen gets a CHANGED alert - instead of cancelling and re-ordering.
